name: TrustedRouter
description: A model router advertising an initial token grant.
overview: The operator says new users can start with 1 million free tokens with no card, using an OpenAI-compatible gateway. It does not establish a recurring allowance; the grant expiry, eligible routes and how different prices affect it are unclear. Provider privacy and routing vary. No signup, inference, billing or model identity was tested.
notes: Base URL https://api.trustedrouter.com/v1. Verify trial eligibility and charges for the selected route.
